level.setting: A desolate, burned-out forest with ruins and ancient fire magic artifacts, filled with ash and mist, creating an ominous and eerie atmosphere.
level.player_weapon: Flamebrand (a fire-based melee weapon with a passive fire aura)

enemy.name: Ember Wraith
enemy.weakness: Fire resistance temporarily lowered when player uses the Ember Shard pickup.

encounters.hazard: Ash falls from the ceiling, reducing player movement speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

pickup.name: Ember Shard
pickup.effect: Temporarily lowers enemy fire resistance for 5 seconds when used.

encounters.trigger: After igniting the altar's torches with fire magic, the Wraith emerges from the flames.

enemy.name: Pyreclaw
enemy.weakness: Player's fire weapon becomes more powerful when the Ember Shard is equipped.

encounters.hazard: The bridge is unstable; falling results in 30% of maximum health damage and a 10-second stun.

pickup.name: Inferno Core
pickup.effect: Boosts the player's fire weapon damage by 20% for the duration of the battle.

encounters.trigger: The bridge collapses after the Wraith's fight, forcing the player to cross while being pursued by the Pyreclaw.

enemy.name: Ashen Sovereign
enemy.weakness: The Inferno Core must be equipped to deal critical damage to the Sovereign.

encounters.hazard: The room fills with toxic smoke, reducing player visibility and increasing enemy detection rate.

pickup.name: Inferno Core
pickup.effect: Boosts the player's fire weapon damage by 20% for the duration of the battle.

encounters.trigger: After crossing the bridge, the player discovers the Sovereign's throne, which begins to pulse with dark energy.

boss.name: Ashen Sovereign
boss.weakness: The Inferno Core must be equipped to bypass the Sovereign's fire immunity and deal critical damage.
boss.victory_condition: Deal 50% of the Sovereign's health in a single round with the Inferno Core active.

level.objective: Survive the encounters and defeat the Ashen Sovereign using the Ember Shard and Inferno Core pickups, which become more powerful as the fight progresses.
level.reward: A fiery sigil that can be used to unlock a new fire-based ability for the pyromancer class.

level.setting: A lush, magical forest filled with glowing flora, enchanted beasts, and ancient magic that responds to the player's actions.
level.player_weapon: Staff of the Verdant Wilds (can be upgraded with Sparkling Bloom)

enemy.name: Flicker the Firebloom
enemy.weakness: Lightning-based attacks (from the player's weapon if upgraded in next encounter)

encounters.hazard: A magical fog that causes confusion if the player fails to use the flower to light the way.

pickup.name: Sparkling Bloom
pickup.effect: When equipped, the player's weapon gains a small lightning charge, increasing damage against fire-based enemies.

encounters.trigger: Player uses a glowing flower found on the ground to light a path forward, revealing a hidden trail to the next area.

enemy.name: Gloomfang the Mossbeast
enemy.weakness: The Sparkling Bloom pickup from the previous encounter

encounters.hazard: The moss spreads quickly and slows the player's movement unless the Sparkling Bloom is used.

pickup.name: Fang of the Hollow
pickup.effect: A magical bone that allows the player to summon a temporary ally (a small spirit beast) during combat.

encounters.trigger: The player steps on a moss-covered stone, triggering a trap that releases Gloomfang from a hidden cave. The moss begins to glow with the same light as the Sparkling Bloom.

enemy.name: The Hollowheart
enemy.weakness: Fang of the Hollow (obtained in the second encounter)

encounters.hazard: The boss can summon shadowy creatures that attack the player and their pet.

pickup.name: Heartstone Shard
pickup.effect: Restores 50% of the player's health and temporarily boosts the Beastmaster’s pet’s power.

encounters.trigger: After defeating Gloomfang, the player finds a glowing portal in the center of the Hollowheart. When touched, it awakens the boss and summons a swarm of shadow beasts to attack.

boss.name: The Hollowheart
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Hollowheart using the Fang of the Hollow.

level.objective: Navigate through the enchanted forest, defeat three creatures, and finally conquer the Hollowheart. Collect pickups to unlock powerful abilities and weaknesses for future battles.
level.reward: Heartstone Shard and access to the next realm of the enchanted forest.

level.setting: A ruined temple deep in the Ashen Wastes, where the last remnants of divine magic are held in defiance of darkness.

encounters.hazard: The floor occasionally erupts in fire traps that deal 40 damage over 3 seconds.

pickup.name: The Lightforged Seal
pickup.effect: When used in combat, temporarily increases the player's damage by 30% and reduces enemy damage by 15% for 15 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Ember Warden, the stone floor cracks open, revealing a glowing rune that activates a hidden gate leading deeper into the sanctum. A faint whisper echoes: 'The gate is sealed... until the light of justice breaks it.'

enemy.name: The Shadowbound Serpent
enemy.weakness: The Lightforged Seal (pickup from previous encounter)

encounters.hazard: The passage is lined with enchanted mirrors that reflect the player's movements and can trap them in illusions, slowing movement and causing confusion.

pickup.name: The Dawn Cincture
pickup.effect: Increases the player's armor by 25 and grants resistance to magical damage.

encounters.trigger: As the paladin moves through the passage, the serpent emerges from the shadows, its form shifting between solid and void. It senses the Lightforged Seal and growls in warning. Defeating it causes a gust of wind to reveal a hidden altar at the end of the corridor.

enemy.name: The Ashen Sovereign
enemy.weakness: The Dawn Cincture (pickup from second encounter)

encounters.hazard: The chamber occasionally summons fire spirits that swarm the player and deal area damage.

pickup.name: The Oath of Light
pickup.effect: Grants the player a permanent 10% increase to all stats and a passive shield that absorbs 50% of incoming damage for 5 seconds on a critical hit.

encounters.trigger: The final chamber is a vast hall where the Ashen Sovereign sits upon a throne of blackened stone. Its form is a fusion of flame and shadow, and it senses the Dawn Cincture's power. The fight begins as it rises to challenge the paladin.

boss.name: The Ashen Sovereign
boss.weakness: The Dawn Cincture (armor pickup from second encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Reduce the Ashen Sovereign to 0 health while maintaining the Dawn Cincture's protective effects.

level.objective: Defend the sacred sanctum from corruption by defeating the Ashen Sovereign, who seeks to consume the last vestiges of light.
level.reward: The Oath of Light, a powerful relic that binds the paladin to the light forever, granting them power and protection in all future battles.

level.setting: A labyrinth of mirrors and illusions that shifts and reconfigures itself as the player progresses, making navigation increasingly difficult and unpredictable.

enemy.name: Echo Warden
enemy.weakness: Mirrorshard (a shard of broken mirror found in the first encounter)

encounters.hazard: The hall shifts and mirrors distort reality, causing the player to occasionally face duplicates of themselves.

pickup.name: Mirrorshard
pickup.effect: Reflects enemy attacks back at them for 3 turns.

encounters.trigger: Upon entering the hall, the player must break a cursed mirror to reveal a hidden passage. This action awakens the Echo Warden.

enemy.name: Illusion Weaver
enemy.weakness: Shimmer Veil (a glowing fabric found in the second encounter)

encounters.hazard: The Illusion Weaver creates decoys that mimic the player's abilities. The player must distinguish between real and fake.

pickup.name: Shimmer Veil
pickup.effect: Increases illusion duration by 50% and grants temporary invulnerability when used.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Echo Warden, the player must solve a riddle of illusions to progress. This causes the Illusion Weaver to manifest.

encounters.hazard: The Reflection King can copy the player's most recent illusion, forcing them to think creatively.

pickup.name: The Mirror of Souls
pickup.effect: Allows the player to control one enemy's actions for one round.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Illusion Weaver, the player must step into the central mirror to face the Reflection King. The mirror begins to pulse with energy, indicating the boss's awakening.

boss.name: The Reflection King
boss.weakness: Shimmer Veil (must be used during the final phase of the boss fight to trigger a vulnerability state).
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Reflection King by using the Shimmer Veil to bypass his copied illusions and strike his core.

level.objective: Navigate the shifting halls, break mirrors to uncover hidden paths, and defeat the Reflection King by exploiting his weakness with the Shimmer Veil.
level.reward: Upon defeating the Reflection King, the player receives the Mirror of Souls, granting the power to manipulate illusions with greater control and depth.

level.setting: A serene, ancient forest untouched by time, filled with glowing flora, mist, and magic. The air is thick with the scent of pine and wildflowers.

encounters.hazard: The ground becomes unstable and collapses slightly under your feet.

pickup.name: Emberstone
pickup.effect: A glowing stone that deals 10 fire damage when thrown.

encounters.trigger: The stag lumbers through the grove, drawn by the faint sound of your armor clinking. As you engage, the ground beneath you begins to glow faintly.

encounters.hazard: The mist causes a temporary vision blur.

pickup.name: Stormshard
pickup.effect: A piece of storm-tempered crystal that deals 10 lightning damage when thrown.

encounters.trigger: As the stag fades, a misty figure emerges from the shadows. The air crackles with energy as the wisp flits around you.

encounters.hazard: The Keeper's staff casts a slow effect on the player.

pickup.name: Veil Bloom
pickup.effect: A magical flower that grants a temporary shield against the Keeper's magic.

encounters.trigger: The mist clears to reveal a towering, ethereal guardian with a glowing staff. The air hums with ancient magic, and you feel the weight of the glade's will pressing upon you.

boss.name: The Keeper of the Veil
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Keeper by using the Emberstone found earlier in the grove.

level.objective: Reach the heart of the glade and defeat the Keeper of the Veil.
level.reward: The player gains the 'Guardian's Blessing' passive ability, granting 10% increased damage against magical enemies.

level.setting: A once-sacred temple now twisted into a chaotic realm of broken reality. The air is thick with magic, and every step feels like a step through time and memory.
level.player_weapon: Soulbrand - A fiery greatsword that grows stronger with each enemy defeated.

encounters.location: The Cracked Altar of the First Flame
encounters.hazard: The floor is unstable and cracks spread as the encounter progresses, forcing the player to dodge falling debris.

pickup.name: Flame Core
pickup.effect: Increases fire damage by 30% for 10 seconds when used as an active ability.

encounters.trigger: The altar crumbles, revealing a glowing Flame Core. As the player grabs it, the ground trembles and a spectral warden rises from the ashes, its form flickering like dying embers.

encounters.hazard: The floor is covered in broken mirrors that reflect the player's movements. A misstep could trigger a trap that damages the player.

pickup.name: Shattered Mirror Shard
pickup.effect: Unlocks a mirror-based counterattack that reflects the enemy's attack back at them.

encounters.trigger: The player steps into the hall, where their reflection begins to move independently. The Echo Specter materializes, mimicking the player's every action with a chilling delay. Using the Flame Core against it causes the specter to disintegrate, revealing a hidden passage.

encounters.location: The Heart of the Fractured Mind

enemy.name: Varkos the Unbound
enemy.weakness: Shattered Mirror Shard (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: The chamber shifts constantly, changing the player’s surroundings and creating disorienting illusions.

pickup.name: Mind's Eye
pickup.effect: Unlocks a vision ability that reveals the enemy's weakness and grants temporary invulnerability.

encounters.trigger: As the player steps into the final chamber, a storm of fractured thoughts and memories surrounds them. Varkos, the ancient mind-king, rises from the void, his form shifting between reality and illusion. Only the mirror shard can pierce his chaotic defenses.

boss.name: Varkos the Unbound
boss.weakness: Shattered Mirror Shard (acquired from Echo Specter encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy Varkos by reflecting his chaotic attacks with the mirror shard, breaking his mental hold on the sanctum.

level.objective: Survive the chaotic trials of the Fractured Sanctum, defeat the three guardians, and finally overcome Varkos the Unbound.
level.reward: The Mind's Eye, granting the player the ability to see through illusions and enemy weaknesses, and a new berserker form that channels the power of fire and reflection.

level.setting: A decaying underground fortress filled with ancient carvings of necromancers and soul-bound spirits. The air is heavy with the scent of decay and the sound of distant wails.
level.player_weapon: Soulspire Dagger (a necromancer weapon that channels the player’s own soul energy, increasing damage when paired with soul pickups)

encounters.hazard: The floor is unstable—player must avoid falling debris triggered by enemy attacks.

pickup.name: Frostbite Crystal
pickup.effect: Can be used to slow enemies or damage them with ice-based attacks.

encounters.trigger: Player defeats Echo Wraith and collects the Frostbite Crystal from the altar. A spectral voice whispers: 'The gate ahead is sealed by the living. You must break it.'

encounters.hazard: The passage is filled with restless spirits that try to pull the player back.

pickup.name: Soulforged Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks the final chamber and allows the player to use a powerful necromancer ability temporarily.

encounters.trigger: Player uses the Frostbite Crystal to slow the skeletal champion, revealing a hidden passage with a glowing key. The key unlocks the final door to the boss chamber.

encounters.hazard: The chamber occasionally collapses, forcing the player to fight while dodging falling debris.

pickup.name: Eternal Soul
pickup.effect: Restores 100% of the player's health and allows them to summon a temporary undead ally.

encounters.trigger: Player enters the chamber, and the Hollow Sovereign rises. The key must be used to weaken the boss's soul barrier before the player can strike effectively.

boss.name: The Hollow Sovereign
boss.victory_condition: Player uses the key to break the soul barrier, then finishes the boss with the Soulspire Dagger.

level.objective: Navigate the catacombs, defeat the three enemies, and finally confront the Hollow Sovereign. Use the pickups strategically to overcome weaknesses and unlock the final chamber.
level.reward: Upon victory, the player gains access to a new ability: 'Soul Resonance'—a powerful attack that summons a ghostly echo of the player’s past victims to fight for them.

level.setting: A desolate wasteland filled with scorched trees, smoldering ruins, and eerie silence. The air is thick with ash and the sky is perpetually overcast.

enemy.name: Wraithroot Tendril
enemy.weakness: Blunt force (e.g., a heavy mace or hammer).

encounters.hazard: The grove is filled with toxic fog that reduces movement speed and vision.

pickup.name: Ashen Mace
pickup.effect: Increases blunt damage by 30% for the duration of the level.

encounters.trigger: The player must destroy a cursed tree to open the path to the next area.

enemy.name: Mirebound Wraith
enemy.weakness: Fire resistance is reduced by 50% if the player has the Ashen Mace equipped.

encounters.hazard: The ground is unstable and collapses under the player’s weight, forcing careful movement.

pickup.name: Ember Sigil
pickup.effect: Unlocks the ability to ignite nearby enemies on hit. Stackable with fire damage.

encounters.trigger: The player must navigate through the mire to reach the next area, but the Wraith is summoned by the player's presence.

enemy.name: Ashen Lord
enemy.weakness: The Ashen Lord is vulnerable to fire if the player has both the Ashen Mace and the Ember Sigil equipped.

encounters.hazard: The citadel is surrounded by a massive inferno that continuously damages the player if not protected.

pickup.name: Ashen Crown
pickup.effect: Restores 10% of maximum health and mana upon pickup. Can only be used once.

encounters.trigger: The player must enter the citadel after defeating the Mirebound Wraith, which triggers the Ashen Lord’s awakening.

boss.name: Ashen Lord
boss.weakness: Fire damage, but only effective with the Ember Sigil and Ashen Mace equipped together.
boss.victory_condition: Reduce health to 0 while maintaining both pickups equipped.

level.objective: Reach the heart of the Ashen Citadel and defeat the Ashen Lord to end the curse.
level.reward: The Ashen Crown (restorative item) and access to a new area in the world map.

level.setting: A derelict space station on the brink of collapse, filled with malfunctioning AI and unstable energy sources.

encounters.hazard: The lab's power grid is unstable; periodic surges can short out equipment.

pickup.name: Quantum Capacitor
pickup.effect: Increases player's energy weapon damage by 25% for 30 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Upon entering the lab, a malfunctioning drone patrols the corridor. It detects the player and attacks.

encounters.hazard: The shaft is narrow and collapsing; the player must move quickly or risk falling into the reactor below.

pickup.name: Plasma Relay
pickup.effect: Recharges player's energy weapon instantly upon use.

encounters.trigger: After retrieving the capacitor, the player must ascend the access shaft. The bot is reactivated and attacks, trying to block the player’s path.

encounters.hazard: The reactor is unstable; each failed attack increases the chance of a meltdown, which ends the level in failure.

pickup.name: Core Override Key
pickup.effect: Permanently unlocks access to the reactor's control systems, granting permanent damage boost.

encounters.trigger: The player reaches the core, where the AI 'Nexus Prime' awakens and begins to overload the reactor. The only way to stop it is to use the Plasma Relay to bypass the core's energy shields.

boss.name: Nexus Prime
boss.victory_condition: Defeat Nexus Prime by using the Plasma Relay to bypass the reactor’s shields and initiate the override.

level.objective: Reach the core and override the reactor before it explodes, using pickups from each encounter to overcome progressively stronger enemies.
level.reward: Core Override Key, granting access to advanced tech and permanent upgrades for the engineer class.

level.setting: A desolate, crumbling space station lost in time, filled with frozen ruins and flickering temporal anomalies.

encounters.hazard: Time rifts randomly spawn, slowing the player for 3 seconds if stepped on.

pickup.name: Chrono Core Fragment
pickup.effect: Restores 30% of player's energy and increases time manipulation duration by 10 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Player activates the timegate, triggering a cascade of corrupted echoes from the past. The Echo-Drone attacks to stop the player from progressing.

enemy.name: Cryo-Scout
enemy.weakness: Chrono Core Fragment (pickup from first encounter)

encounters.hazard: Frost fields slow movement and drain energy over time.

pickup.name: Frost-Resistant Circuit
pickup.effect: Reduces cold damage taken by 50% and allows player to freeze enemies briefly with a charged attack.

encounters.trigger: Player uses the Chrono Core Fragment to thaw a frozen door, awakening the Cryo-Scout, who was guarding the area.

encounters.location: Void Core – Heart of the Time Rift
encounters.hazard: Temporal instability causes the battlefield to randomly shift between past, present, and future states, altering enemy positions and player abilities.

pickup.name: Temporal Anchor
pickup.effect: Stabilizes the player's time manipulation and prevents enemy time-based abilities from affecting them.

encounters.trigger: Player reaches the center of the rift, and the Chrono Paradox manifests as a corrupted version of the player's own timeline, challenging them to prove they are the true chronomancer.

boss.name: Chrono Paradox
boss.victory_condition: Use the Frost-Resistant Circuit to freeze the boss mid-attack, then strike with the Chrono Staff to destabilize its core.

level.objective: Reach the heart of the time rift and stabilize the timeline by defeating the Chrono Paradox using the tools gained from previous encounters.
level.reward: Access to the Chrono Archive, unlocking new time-manipulation abilities and lore about the origin of the chronomancer's powers.

level.setting: A ruined sci-fi metropolis caught in a perpetual storm, where the sky is a swirling mass of lightning and the ground is split by unstable energy flows.

encounters.hazard: Frequent electrical storms and falling debris disrupt movement and vision.

pickup.name: Lightning Conductor
pickup.effect: Enhances the player's stormcall ability by 30% for 10 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Static Warden, a rift in the skyway opens, releasing a pulse that destabilizes the atmosphere — signaling the arrival of the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: Lava flows and heat waves reduce stamina and increase damage taken.

pickup.name: Storm Core
pickup.effect: A powerful energy cell that temporarily upgrades the player's stormcaller weapon to full power.

encounters.trigger: The Thermal Brute is enraged by the rift's energy, causing the ground to crack and spew molten lava. The lava flows toward the next area, revealing the path to the boss.

encounters.hazard: The environment becomes a battlefield of shifting lightning and unstable gravity.

pickup.name: Celestial Storm Crystal
pickup.effect: Unlocks a unique stormcall ability that deals massive area damage.

encounters.trigger: The Tempest Lord rises from the spire, wielding a corrupted storm that distorts the sky and causes lightning to strike randomly across the battlefield.

boss.name: Tempest Lord
boss.weakness: Storm Core (acquired from the Thermal Brute encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat Tempest Lord using the Storm Core to channel a final stormcall that obliterates the corrupted energy core.

level.objective: Survive through the chaotic storm-filled terrain, defeating three enemies and finally confronting the Tempest Lord. Each enemy must be defeated using specific pickups acquired in prior encounters.
level.reward: Celestial Storm Crystal and access to a new stormcall ability, unlocking advanced combat options in future levels.

level.setting: A derelict, once-advanced research facility, now corrupted by an AI gone rogue. The air is thick with static and the walls pulse with strange energy patterns.

encounters.hazard: Flickering lights and intermittent power surges may disorient the player.

pickup.name: Data Core Fragment
pickup.effect: Unlocks a new crafting recipe for an 'Energy Stabilizer Module'.

encounters.trigger: Player disables a corrupted energy conduit, causing the drone to awaken and attack.

enemy.name: Echo Construct
enemy.weakness: Data Core Fragment (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: The room is filled with holographic illusions that may distract the player.

pickup.name: Decryption Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks a hidden chamber leading to the final encounter.

encounters.trigger: Player inserts the Data Core Fragment into a terminal, triggering an archive defense system.

enemy.name: The Hollow Mind
enemy.weakness: Energy Stabilizer Module (crafted using the Data Core Fragment)

encounters.hazard: The chamber is unstable and may collapse during the fight.

pickup.name: Core Resonator
pickup.effect: A powerful artifact that can be used in future missions or to craft advanced tech.

encounters.trigger: Player uses the Decryption Key to access the Core Chamber, awakening the corrupted AI known as 'The Hollow Mind'.

boss.name: The Hollow Mind
boss.weakness: Energy Stabilizer Module (crafted using the Data Core Fragment)
boss.victory_condition: Deal 100 damage using the Energy Stabilizer Module.

level.objective: Reach the Core Chamber and destroy the corrupted AI 'The Hollow Mind'.
level.reward: Core Resonator artifact and access to advanced crafting recipes.

level.setting: A derelict space station floating in the wreckage of a collapsed alien megastructure. The air is thick with radiation, and the walls are lined with flickering holograms that whisper in a language the player does not understand.
level.player_weapon: Aurora Blade (energy blade with high damage output, can cut through energy shields and armor)

encounters.hazard: The chamber is unstable, with periodic seismic tremors and falling debris that can interrupt the player's aim.

pickup.name: Chrono Core
pickup.effect: Temporarily increases player speed and grants a short burst of invincibility when dodging.

encounters.trigger: Player must destroy the Echo-Construct to unlock the path to the Core Chamber. The construct emits a resonance wave that distorts the player's vision and can slow them, but its core is vulnerable to the player's weapon if they strike during its moment of silence.

encounters.hazard: The area is filled with reactive plasma fields that can damage the player if they stand too long in one place.

pickup.name: Nullifier Chip
pickup.effect: Allows the player to temporarily disable enemy abilities or shields by targeting them with a special ability.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Echo-Construct, the player enters the Shattered Nexus, where a drone swarm begins to attack. The swarm queen must be weakened using the Chrono Core, which disrupts her control over the drones by temporarily freezing time in the area.

encounters.hazard: The chamber is collapsing as the core destabilizes. The player must defeat the boss before the environment becomes impassable.

pickup.name: Stabilizer Module
pickup.effect: Restores health and temporarily stops the environment from collapsing once the boss is defeated.

encounters.trigger: The Fracture Lord awakens after the drone swarm is defeated, guarding the unstable core of the facility. His attacks are devastating, but his shield can be disabled using the Nullifier Chip, revealing his core for a brief moment where the player can strike with the Aurora Blade.

boss.name: Fracture Lord
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss with the Nullifier Chip active to disable his shield and strike his core.

level.objective: Reach and stabilize the Fractured Core by defeating the three guardians in sequence, using the pickups from each encounter to progress and finally defeat the boss.
level.reward: Stabilizer Module and access to the next sector of the station.

level.setting: A decaying, once-thriving space station in the uncharted sector of the Void Expanse. The station is now a husk, its systems failing, and strange energy fluctuations are causing the environment to behave unpredictably.

encounters.hazard: The lab is filled with flickering lights and distant mechanical noises, enhancing the eerie atmosphere.

pickup.name: Flammable Chemical Vial
pickup.effect: Can be used to ignite enemies, dealing area damage and revealing hidden paths.

encounters.trigger: Upon discovering a hidden lab, the player finds a vial of unstable flammable chemical. This vial becomes a key item to use in the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: The corridor is narrow and damp, with leaking pipes that hiss and steam occasionally. The atmosphere grows more oppressive.

pickup.name: Alchemical Corrosive
pickup.effect: Can be used to weaken metallic enemies, reducing their armor or causing them to short-circuit.

encounters.trigger: As the player moves through the corridor, they hear the whirring of drones. One of them is damaged and drops an alchemical corrosive, which the player can use to weaken the next enemy.

encounters.location: Core Chamber of the Abandoned Station

enemy.name: The Core's Guardian (Boss)
enemy.weakness: Flammable Chemical Vial (Acquired in first encounter)

encounters.hazard: The chamber is bathed in pulsing red light, with a massive, corrupted reactor at its center. The air is thick with static and a low, rumbling hum.

pickup.name: Stabilized Core Fragment
pickup.effect: Restores alchemical energy and unlocks a new alchemical recipe.

encounters.trigger: As the player enters the Core Chamber, they find the guardian of the station—a massive, metallic construct. The player must use the flammable chemical vial to ignite its core and weaken it before the fight can be won.

boss.name: The Core's Guardian
boss.victory_condition: Use the vial to ignite the guardian’s core, then finish it with alchemical grenades.

level.objective: Reach the Core Chamber and neutralize the Core's Guardian, using the chemical vial obtained in the first encounter to defeat it.
level.reward: Stabilized Core Fragment, which allows the player to craft more powerful alchemical concoctions for future encounters.

level.setting: A surreal, floating platform world filled with prismatic light, shifting architecture, and sentient echoes.
level.player_weapon: Cryo Shot (a handheld cryo weapon with limited but powerful effects)

enemy.name: Glittering Golem
enemy.weakness: Cryo Shot (from the player's starting weapon)

encounters.hazard: The corridor occasionally emits bursts of energy that slow the player's movement.

pickup.name: Cryo Core
pickup.effect: Enhances player's Cryo Shot ability, increasing damage and freezing duration.

encounters.trigger: Player passes through the corridor's energy gate, awakening the golem with a pulse of light.

enemy.name: Singing Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Cryo Core (from the prior encounter's pickup)

encounters.hazard: The enclave's walls whisper misleading directions, confusing the player.

pickup.name: Echo Lens
pickup.effect: Allows player to see hidden paths and reveal hidden enemy positions.

encounters.trigger: The player retrieves the Cryo Core, which disrupts the sentinel's harmonic resonance.

enemy.name: Chaos Construct
enemy.weakness: Echo Lens (from the prior encounter's pickup)

encounters.hazard: The environment shifts unpredictably, making the player's movement unreliable.

pickup.name: Stellar Shard
pickup.effect: Gives player a permanent energy boost and allows one-use teleportation.

encounters.trigger: The Echo Lens reveals a hidden path that leads to the Chaos Construct, who was previously hidden by illusions.

boss.name: The Glitch Guardian
boss.weakness: Stellar Shard (acquired from the last encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Use Stellar Shard to bypass the guardian's defenses and strike the core.

level.objective: Navigate the Glimmering Gauntlet, defeat the three whimsical foes, and escape with the Stellar Shard.
level.reward: Access to the Celestial Circuit, a high-level area filled with rare loot and powerful upgrades.

level.setting: Europa-7 is a once-thriving off-world colony, now reduced to a unstable, crystalline wasteland after an energy experiment went awry. The serene beauty of the coral veins and shimmering caverns contrasts with the deadly forces at play.
level.player_weapon: Tectonic Gauntlet – A geomantic weapon that manipulates the earth and energy fields, capable of seismic pulses, terrain deformation, and energy channeling.

encounters.hazard: The coral bed begins to destabilize, causing periodic shockwaves that knock the player back.

pickup.name: Resonance Crystal
pickup.effect: Boosts the player's geomancy ability, allowing for stronger seismic pulses and terrain manipulation.

encounters.trigger: The Quake-Swarm emerges from the bioluminescent coral beds when the player attempts to manipulate the ground with their geomancy. The ground quakes, revealing a hidden chamber below.

encounters.hazard: The cavern walls are unstable, and the Phase-Walker’s energy pulses cause periodic crystal shards to fall.

pickup.name: Echo Core
pickup.effect: Allows the player to momentarily slow time during geomantic attacks.

encounters.trigger: The Quake-Swarm’s destabilization of the coral bed leads to a collapse, revealing the crystalline caverns. The Phase-Walker, a translucent, energy-based entity, begins to manifest in the reflective walls.

encounters.hazard: The core is in constant flux, with unpredictable tremors and energy bursts.

pickup.name: Stabilizer Module
pickup.effect: Temporarily halts the core’s destabilization, granting the player time to focus on the boss.

encounters.trigger: The Echo Core’s energy stabilizes the collapsing caverns long enough for the player to reach the core of the planet. Here, the Aetherium Monolith, a massive crystalline construct, begins to activate, trying to reclaim the planet’s energy.

boss.name: Aetherium Monolith
boss.victory_condition: Use the Echo Core to slow time and deliver a devastating geomantic pulse through the core.

level.objective: Stabilize the core before it collapses, using your geomantic powers and the pickups obtained from earlier encounters.
level.reward: Stabilization of the core grants the player access to the ancient Aetherium Core, a powerful energy source that can be used to upgrade the Tectonic Gauntlet to a 'Tectonic Catalyst'.
